title: Human flow
summary: The district's walkers as agents: every walker of the urban-science domain's movement model on the Hoddle Grid's streets, its departures set by the City's counters each way, moving with the clock; the counters' readings beside what they count; a street closed or made one-way and an event's crowd brought to a street, with how the walkers redistribute; the street's regime decided online by POMCP on the walkers themselves; every record they make marked simulated.

layers.title: walkers on the streets (a model)
layers.about: Every walker of the model at the clock's hour, moving between its places every ten seconds, keeping left; coloured by its pattern (passing through, arriving at work, leaving, between buildings, visiting shops, an event's crowd) or by what it is doing (walking, waiting at red, queued at a full street, standing at the event); the streets beneath by their density, or by how many more or fewer walk them in a scenario; the queues at full streets' mouths; a simulated record's events in pale violet glass.

layers.title: counters: counted and simulated
layers.about: At each of the City's counters in the district that counts each way, two columns at the clock's hour: what it counts on average at that hour of the week (2025–26) and what the walkers passing its line make it read.

tools.title: Walkers of the district
tools.about: Who is on the district's streets at the clock's hour and through the day; each counter's reading beside its count and the calibration's expectation; how the walkers' departures were set from the counters.

tools.title: A street closed or one-way
tools.about: A street, or a block of it picked on the map, closed to walkers passing through or made one-way for a few hours: the walkers run again beside the same hours as built, and how they redistribute is drawn on the map; or all three regimes side by side.

tools.title: An event's crowd
tools.about: The City's event permits on the district's streets, with what the counters counted that day; a crowd brought to a street and the walkers around it; the record they make, every event simulated; the street's regime decided online by POMCP on the walkers, the crowd's size unknown.

source: The urban-science domain's movement module (walkers as agents on nomos's agents engine, regimes as decisions on tyche's POMCP; ADR 0075), calibrated as the district-economy flow study calibrates its flow (research/experiments/2026-11-05-a-district-economy-as-a-flow)

planned.title: Composition at entry and departure
planned.about: The instrument Street Oceanography §20 asks for and nobody has built: carried properties registered at entry and departure on the same units, with a comparison population.

planned.title: Crowds beyond the kinematic wave
planned.about: Two-dimensional crowd models (Hughes's continuum, social-force agents) on the walkable surface, offered as representations.
